profile.headline: Tech Lead | Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I thrive at the intersection of product and engineering. Understanding a problem to its core and leading its solution with momentum is my sweet spot. 

I bring industry experience from diverse domains, from various levels of the tech stack and a background in AI and Evolutionary Computation. 

Most recently as part of Hazel Health, providing virtual physical and mental healthcare to students in public schools k-12. I have led engineers through many successful launches, enabling the team to produce its best work, unblocking and providing strong technical guidance. 

Previously at Globality (AI powered procurement sourcing), I have worked with a myriad of technologies the latest being Python/Flask/Alchemy, GraphQL, microservices, Postgres, in an agile environment, primarily as a Backend Engineer.

Born and raised in Habana Cuba, lived in many places across the globe, love traveling and full cultural immersions, adventure over possessions, latin dance, the beach.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Building, leading and most importantly gluing it all together as a team lead.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Palo Alto, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Globality delivers autonomous sourcing by leveraging machine learning and data-driven insights.

I have led numerous engineering efforts from design to production, actively participating in all phases including the product engineering requirements handshake, planning, implementation, testing and deployment. Coordinated team efforts across the organization to ensure completion.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Develop Python/Flask APIs for several customer facing applications 
-Develop Front-end features for the main product's Admin Console using latest best practices in React/Redux/Enzyme
-Contribute to 3 APIs and 3 web applications code bases that support the company's services
-PagerDuty monthly rotations covering all servers and apps (Heroku logs, Logentries, New Relic, Bugsnag)
-Participate in customer interviews and market research about new potential features.

positions.title: Software Engineer & Founder
positions.description:
Kapelee (Alpha) is a Django/NodeJS-powered site on a mission to introduce people to the adventurous side of a healthy and thriving life. It gives lifestyle bloggers/coaches the spotlight to share upcoming classes, experiences on healthy living, recipes, travel adventures, all in a central place. Users, on the other hand, can search for these coaches by topic of interest and discover people who inspire them to change with a story that resembles theirs. 

The aim was a very fast user experience that felt uncluttered and light, just as a simple healthy lifestyle. Thus a very light weight asynchronous web server seemed right. Used Backbone in both server (NodeJS) and client to keep things homogeneous and object oriented.

Designed current preliminary look of site using Bootstrap.
Django REST Framework for API, NodeJS/Express for Web Framework.
Use Backbone in client and server.
jQuery for various client side utilities.
Grunt for running tasks and gluing all packages together.
Handlebars for server and client templating.
ElasticSearch search engine.
Redis for session management.
PostgreSQL.
Deployed on Heroku.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
*Developed APIs and libraries for media and document management in IBM Content Management suite.
*Developed features for DB2 kernel with BLU Acceleration (Column based DB for in-memory computing and analytics).
*Developed features for DB2 kernel and pureXML Technologies.

Technologies: DB2/MySQL, Java, C++, C, XML, Eclipse, Git, Clearcase/Clearquest, Linux/Unix.

positions.title: ExtremeBlue Technical Intern
positions.description:
Developed healthcare components and business intelligence process workflows to serve as a framework for clinical applications using WebSphere tools. Integrated framework with the Eclipse Open Healthcare Framework. Created business analytics using the open source Business Intelligence Reporting Tool (BIRT) and WebSphere Monitor and Portal Server. Delivered prototype to IBM's customer at the end of summer. Pitched and presented project at an expo to CEO in IBM's Headquarters. 

Technologies: Java, Java Web Services, WSDL, IBM Websphere Suite (Process Server, Integration Developer, Enterprise Service Bus, Application Business Monitor), DB2, Eclipse BIRT (Business Intelligence Reporting Tool), Eclipse, SVN.
